tools.name: get_weather_data
tools.description: General-purpose query -- supports every real dataset (see the enum below). Prefer the dedicated convenience tools when they fit: get_storm_history (one county's past storms), get_risk_forecast (one county's forecast), get_address_report (one property's 365-day snapshot), get_property_storm_history_r

tools.name: get_storm_history
tools.description: FREE preview of reported and radar-detected past storm events (hail, wind, tornado, flooding) for a county: event counts, storm types, measured severities and repeat-hit properties.

tools.name: get_risk_forecast
tools.description: FREE AtlasCast forecast for a county: severe weather risk for future leads over the coming days, with county risk grades and property exposure. Forecast risk, not storms that already happened. Refreshed several times a day from NOAA models.

tools.name: get_property_storm_history_report
tools.description: The FULL real archive for one property: hail, wind, flood/heavy rain, lightning, and tornado, 2003 to present, in one report -- not the 365-day snapshot (use get_address_report for that). Free preview shows the real report-line count and exact price before anything is paid. Paid report is billed per

tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Real live point-in-time weather for ANY US coordinate -- 164 real HRRR-based fields, hourly refresh, plus MRMS precip nowcast and NWS severe alerts. FREE by default: the lean 10-field response needs no account. details=true returns the full 164-field pull, billed $0.0002/call (not per-address).

tools.name: get_address_report
tools.description: ONE property, 365-day snapshot: past storm history (up to 365 days back, not the full archive) plus current forecast risk. Give an address with county+state, or lat/lon.
